description: Integral JSON numbers such as 0.0 and 3.0 are accepted for skip and limit.

age.statement: SELECT * FROM cypher('age_graph', $$ MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name SKIP 0 LIMIT 3 $$) AS (name agtype)

sql_pgq.statement: SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS Person) COLUMNS (p.name)) LIMIT 3 OFFSET 0

duck_pgq.statement: SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS Person) COLUMNS (p.name)) LIMIT 3 OFFSET 0
